entities.name: Naru
entities.description: Giant fighter from Kush, champion and later master of the House of Bolk.

entities.name: House of Bolk
entities.description: House Naru served as champion and later master.

entities.name: Garth
entities.description: Fought and beat Naru twice; became his friend.

entities.name: Lorrin of Kestha
entities.description: Defeated by Naru in the first round of the 998th Festival.

entities.name: Time of Troubles
entities.description: Event after which Naru became master of Bolk.

entities.name: Arena
entities.description: Place of Naru's fights with Garth.

events.summary: Garth beat Naru outside the Arena; after Garth returned his stolen spells, they became fast friends.
Naru defeated Lorrin of Kestha in the first round of the 998th Festival.
events.quote: He defeated Lorrin of Kestha in the first round of the 998th Festival.

events.summary: Naru lost to Garth again in the Arena, knocked unconscious despite a deathmatch.
events.quote: Naru later lost to Garth again in the Arena

events.summary: After the Time of Troubles Naru became master of the House of Bolk.
events.quote: Naru became the new master of the House of Bolk

relations.note: Master after the Time of Troubles.
